sahneler.metin: Fire broke out deep in an Illinois coal mine.
It trapped hundreds underground, and two hundred fifty nine men and boys died.
Bales of hay for the mine's mules were on a cart.
A kerosene torch dripped onto them and they caught fire.
Flames spread to the mine's timbers.
The shaft was sealed to smother the fire.
A group of miners survived for eight days behind a wall they built.
Illinois passed mine safety and compensation laws afterward.
